Featuring southeast Asian tropical style, Sanya Haiyun Resort Hotel offers accommodations with panoramic sea views and direct access to a beach area. It is only 6 minutes drive from Sanya Phoenix Airport, 8 minutes drive from the city and 15 minutes drive from the nearest railway station.

The hotel has a forest-themed childrens restaurant, a marine theme childrens playground and water slides for children. It also boast tennis courts, a 2000-square-metre outdoor pool and pools of various temperatures.

Offering sea views from its private balcony and large windows allowing for lots of natural light, all air-conditioned units come with a minibar, a flat-screen cable TV, a personal safe and ironing facilities. The attached bathroom has a bathtub. Butler service is provided upon request.

Blending in by relaxing at the spa centre, working out at the fitness centre or making use of the business centre seems nice. Convenient guest services include currency exchange, luggage storage and concierge service. Laundry, dry cleaning and ironing facilities are all available.

Bali-style Western Restaurant serves cuisines from around the world, while Yunhexuan Restaurant offers a selection of local Chinese cuisine and a mix of Southeast Asian flavours. Seafood buffet hotpots can be enjoyed at the Fishermans Wharf Restaurant with live music performances. Guests are required to show a valid government-issued ID card or passport upon check-in.

The property serves daily buffet breakfast. Children below 1.2 metres dine free of charge. Children from 1.2-1.5 metres dine with half price. Children above 1.5 metres dine with full price.

The property provides chargeable drop-off service to Phoenix International Airport twice per day at 11:00 and 17:00. If you need to take the shuttle bus please kindly wait at the on-site Concierge Counter at least 15 minutes before bus departure.

Please note that extra bed/crib is subject to availability at the time of check-in. Extra bed price might be different on public holidays. Please contact the Resort for more details.

All rooms have double or king-size beds, individually regulated air conditioning units and a balcony or terrace. Internet access is also provided in the rooms.

Address: DADONGHAI SCENIC ZONA SANYA
Description:
This hotel enjoys a seaside location in Dadonghai and the scenic zone of Luhuitou in Sanya, called the oriental Hawaii. It is the first seashore garden resort hotel in the Dadonghai zone.

The hotel has a mountain backdrop and overlooks the sea. The hotel has a total of 185 guest rooms and spans an area of over 10,000 m². Fully air-conditioned, the hotel features a lobby with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, currency exchange facilities and lift access. The sea view pavilion includes a Chinese Meal Hall and there is also a bar and café on site. A large meeting hall can be found on the 2nd floor.

Guest rooms are available in the following categories: deluxe garden view room, deluxe sea view room, advanced executive suite, sea view honeymoon suite and deluxe sea view suite. The air-conditioned rooms are all en suite with a bathtub/shower, and further facilities include a hairdryer, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and an in-room safe. There is a kitchenette with a minibar/fridge, oven, microwave and tea and coffee making facilities. The rooms also come with central heating and a balcony or terrace.

The hotel features a swimming pool with water aerobics and the Coconut Bar poolside. The Mingzhu fitness-training centre offers luxury VIP Finnish and Turkish saunas and Chinese, Thai and Hong Kong massages. The hotel also includes a gym, which is free of charge for guests, and facilities for pool/snooker, table tennis, tennis, golf, bowling and badminton. Guests can play beach volleyball on the nearby beach or try their hand at a range of water sports, including waterskiing, jet skiing, motor boating and diving.

The Chinese Meal Hall serves western-style food. Guests can enjoy a range of carefully cooked dishes, such as Sichuan, Cantonese and Chaozhou cuisine, as well as authentic western meals and Japanese riori.

Description:
This hotel is located on the shores of the sandy Dadonghai Bay and enjoys breathtaking sea views in an ideal setting. The centre of Sanya is just 3 km away.

A magnificent fountain stands at the entrance to this city beach hotel and the rooms and lobby here are tastefully decorated. Most of the 206 elegant and deluxe rooms have great sea views and it is ideal for both business travellers and holidaymakers alike. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area with a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, a currency exchange facility, a cloakroom and lift access. It also offers a bar, a TV lounge, a restaurant, conference facilities and WLAN/Internet access. Guests may take advantage of the room and laundry services and there is parking for those arriving by car. Those wishing to explore the area on bicycle will find a cycle hire station at the hotel.

All rooms are equipped with modern facilities such as air conditioning, cable TV, direct dial telephone with international and domestic direct dialling, a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and a hairdryer. They are also equipped with Internet access, a kitchen with a minibar/fridge and a microwave, an ironing set, a king-size or double bed and a safe. Furthermore, either a balcony or a terrace is provided in all accommodation as standard.

The hotel features a sauna, an outdoor swimming pool, a sun terrace with sun loungers and parasols and a karaoke facility. There is a steam bath, table tennis and a gym and guests can also enjoy tennis and spa and massage treatments.

The hotel has a Chinese and Western restaurant and the chefs here specialise in local delicacies and seafood. Guests can also enjoy barbecued food.
